rounds: Two weeks of showing up in the same gear, holding the routine — that's not nothing, that's actually the floor staying solid. But the Apollo ring moment? Someone walked right up and handed you an opening, and you closed the door on the half-naked man. That one went to the Joy Police.
pattern: They're letting the routine run fine, then swooping in the second someone else notices.
focus: One conversation where you let the ring explain itself — even halfway.
